draftedFindings.title: first panics when n exceeds the slice length
draftedFindings.body:
`&items[..n]` panics with `range end index out of range` whenever `n > items.len()` — e.g. `first(&[1, 2, 3], 5)`.

The sibling `last` function deliberately handles the same case with `items.len().saturating_sub(n)` and documents it ("or all of them when there are fewer"), so `first` is both a reachable panic in the public API and inconsistent with the crate's own convention.

Clamp the index, e.g. `&items[..n.min(items.len())]`, and update the doc comment to mirror `last`'s: `/// The first \`n\` items, or all of them when there are fewer.`
